atmc_shovel_desc: A terrain tool for lowering ground.
atmc_level_square_desc: Levels ground to the world grid based on player position. Use Shift + click to level from the pointed position instead (this smooths the terrain).
atmc_raise_precision_desc: Raises ground precisely; use the scroll wheel to set the target height.
atmc_path_square_desc: Creates a dirt path aligned to the world grid without changing ground height.
atmc_paved_square_desc: Creates a paved square aligned to the world grid and levels it from player position. Use Shift + click to level from the pointed position instead (this smooths the terrain).
atmc_paved_path_desc: Creates a paved path without changing ground height.
atmc_paved_path_square_desc: Creates a paved square aligned to the world grid without changing ground height.
atmc_remove_desc: Restores the original ground height and paint. Hold Alt and use the mouse wheel to change the area.
atmc_cultivate_square_desc: Cultivates a square aligned to the world grid and levels it from player position. Use Shift + click to level from the pointed position instead (this smooths the terrain).
atmc_cultivate_path_desc: Cultivates ground without changing its height.
atmc_cultivate_path_square_desc: Cultivates a square aligned to the world grid without changing ground height.
atmc_replant_square_desc: Restores natural vegetation in a square aligned to the world grid without changing ground height.
atmc_vanilla_level_desc: Levels ground based on player position. Use Shift + click to level from the pointed position instead (this smooths the terrain).
atmc_vanilla_raise_desc: Raises ground up to 8 m above its original height.
atmc_vanilla_path_desc: Creates a dirt path without changing ground height.
atmc_vanilla_paved_desc: Creates a paved path and levels it from player position. Use Shift + click to level from the pointed position instead (this smooths the terrain).
atmc_vanilla_cultivate_desc: Cultivates ground and levels it from player position. Use Shift + click to level from the pointed position instead (this smooths the terrain).
atmc_vanilla_replant_desc: Restores natural vegetation without changing ground height.
